policy: Only patches that make the game playable as it was meant to be: crash fixes, fixes for rendering RPCS3 gets wrong, and restoring original speed. No cheats, no debug menus, no skipped intros, no FPS unlocks, and no patch that only trades picture quality for speed. An entry is exact: hash, description, the title and app version it is filed under, the file it comes from (RPCS3's official patch.yml, or the player's imported_patch.yml for community patches), and the sha256 of its body as reviewed. If the body changes, the entry stops applying until it is reviewed again.

patches.source: RPCS3 official patch database (rpcs3.net, patch engine 1.2), author Dobrido. Notes: 'Restores exact PS3 behavior: forces the PS3 NTSC frametime (1/59.94) and caps logic at 59.94 steps/s, fixing RPCS3 overspeed while keeping frame-precise physics intact. Requires Vblank NTSC Fixup enabled.' Reviewed 2026-09-23: 39 be32/alloc writes, code only, no gameplay value touched. The earlier body (40 writes into a fixed 0x00aad000 scratch area) was replaced upstream by an alloc without a version bump; that earlier body is NOT approved.
RPCS3 official patch database (rpcs3.net, patch engine 1.2), author Dobrido. Same notes as the God of War: HD entry. Reviewed 2026-09-23: 39 writes, code only.

patches.description: Bug Fix: Quit to Menu Crash
patches.source: RPCS3 official patch database, authors ZEROx, illusion. Notes: 'Fixes a rare bug where quitting to menu causes a game crash.' 7 writes. Not a cheat, no visual change.

RPCS3 official patch database, ZEROx/illusion. Notes: 'Improves performance slightly by using GPU path for lighting. Fixes lighting issues in Chapter 9 when shining the beams of light onto the statues.'

Community patch (ZEROx), not in the official database; present in the player's imported_patch.yml. Notes: 'Fixes flickering water reflections + Heat Wave under Approximate ZCull (avoids Precise ZCull, very costly).'

RPCS3 official patch database. Notes: 'Uses GPU (RSX) path for lighting effects instead of SPU. Fixes rendering of lighting effects that are broken via SPU path and greatly improves performance over it.'
RPCS3 official patch database. Notes: 'Version 2.0 fixes high levels of bloom in some areas (1.10 and 1.19). Version 3.0 fixes crash in some multiplayer levels (1.19 only).'

patches.description: Heat waves Approximate ZCull fix [Communautaire - ZEROx]
patches.source: Community patch (ZEROx, RPCS3 wiki 'Canary'), not in the official database; present in the player's imported_patch.yml. Enables the Heat Wave effect under Approximate ZCull instead of the much slower Precise ZCull.
